fact: The ministry's 2023 report states that under e-TAMKEEN (2019-2023, with Enabel) it ran 159 training courses for 1,770 officials from the 14 sectors concerned, and that the programme closed on 18 October 2023 having trained over 6,800 beneficiaries.
title: حصيلة وزارة الانتقال الرقمي وإصلاح الإدارة برسم سنة 2023
